security.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:; connect-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Visual git undo from your reflog
bundle.longDescription: Reads your reflog, previews the undo, and generates the command. The optional desktop build can also run the reset itself, guarded and after taking a backup branch.
